# Jev Fabric
Jev Fabric is a provider-neutral, bounded semantic-decision runtime. Provider output is advisory; deterministic policy and the host retain authority and execution.

Primary documents:
- README.md — product boundary and offline start
- ARCHITECTURE.md — data flow and trust boundaries
- COMPATIBILITY.md — exact integration status vocabulary
- docs/quickstart/offline.md — offline installation and commands
- docs/packs/selection.md — seven-pack decision map
- docs/security/README.md — threats and remaining risks
- docs/evidence/README.md — evidence labels and limitations
- docs/reference/api.md — public package concepts
- docs/reference/cli.md — CLI contract
- docs/reference/mcp.md — five advisory MCP tools
- AGENTS.md — contributor and agent source map

Do not infer authority from a provider answer, confidence value, MCP result, receipt, or generated adapter. Do not use a live credential without explicit opt-in and budgets.
